readme: Pinned inputs for scripts/build-roster.mjs. The mod name lives HERE and nowhere else.
PITFALLS Pitfall 3: Showdown's mod naming floats. The mod that today resolves to
Regulation M-B is expected to become M-C when M-C ships, with a new frozen mod
appearing for M-B. A script with the mod name hardcoded would silently snapshot a
different regulation with no error signal. Changing a mod name is therefore a
reviewable edit to this file, and the count gate below is what makes the swap loud.
expectedCounts is written on first generation and asserted on every run afterwards.
Rewriting it requires the explicit --accept-drift flag.
upstreamPinNote: pokemon-showdown@0.11.11 publishes no gitHead in its package manifest and the tarball
carries no .git metadata, so the smogon/pokemon-showdown commit this release was cut
from cannot be resolved offline. No SHA has been invented here.
The pin of record is therefore the npm version plus the subresource integrity hash
above, which is the same value committed in package-lock.json and is what npm ci
verifies on every install. Substituting different bytes for this version fails the
install, so the pin is enforced, not merely documented.
